name: 言犀智能体平台
desc: 京东云一站式 Agent 开发平台
desc_zh: 京东云一站式 Agent 开发平台
solves: Building a shippable agent from scratch means wiring a model, connecting a knowledge base and tuning prompts. The platform starts you from ready-made industry templates.
solves_zh: 从零搭一个能上线的智能体，要配模型、接知识库、调提示词。平台提供现成的行业模板改。
best_for: When you need a customer-service, sales-assistant or supply-chain agent without an engineering team behind every change.
best_for_zh: 要做客服、导购或供应链场景的智能体，且不想全靠工程团队。
notes: 电商与供应链行业 Know-how 最深的智能体搭建平台，沉淀了一百余个行业方案模板 来源：https://baike.baidu.com/item/%E8%A8%80%E7%8A%80%E6%99%BA%E8%83%BD%E4%BD%93%E5%B9%B3%E5%8F%B0/64733051
